label: Town of Dorset
header:
# Town of Dorset municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 7; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Dorset Selectboard members: Megan Thorn (Chair), Henry Chandler (Vice Chair), Alison Clarke, Frank Parent, and Jim Salsgiver.

Town of Dorset 2025 Town Report (dorsetvt.org): the elected-officers table (p. 6) lists the same five, and the town's official newsletter reported the March 3, 2026 results re-electing Chandler (203 votes), Salsgiver (153), and Parent (268) to the three seats that stood.

Town of Dorset 2025 Town Report (dorsetvt.org): the APPOINTED officers table (p. 5) lists Jennifer Comar as Town Clerk; the town's official newsletter reports she was appointed Town Clerk effective January 1, 2026 after serving two years as Assistant Clerk. The office is appointive in Dorset.
Town of Dorset 2025 Town Report (dorsetvt.org): the APPOINTED officers table (p. 5) lists Jennifer Comar as Town Treasurer, an appointive office in Dorset.

Town of Dorset 2025 Town Report (dorsetvt.org): the elected-officers table lists Kevin O'Toole as Moderator, and the 2026 Warning placed the office on the ballot. The town's official newsletter reported the Journal's town-meeting tally recording O'Toole re-elected March 3, 2026 with 313 votes, unopposed; no official tally sheet is posted, and the result rests on that reporting.

Town of Dorset 2025 Town Report (dorsetvt.org): the elected-officers table lists Ryan Matteson as First Constable with a term expiring March 2026, and the 2026 Warning placed the office on the ballot. Structure only: no official source publishes the 2026 outcome; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Town of Dorset 2025 Town Report (dorsetvt.org): the signed Delinquent Tax Report (p. 59) is executed by Robert Gaiotti as 'Town Manager/Delinquent Tax Collector': the Town Manager serves as the town's collector of delinquent taxes, an appointed holder.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists ten Dorset justices of the peace: Russell Appelman, Howard W Coolidge, Tom Cooper, Lee Fox, Jennifer Halligan Comar, Michelle Pagan, Sandra "Sandy" Pinsonault, John "Will" Rucker, Roger Squire, and Bo Thorn.

Town of Dorset 2025 Town Report (dorsetvt.org): the elected-officers table lists the same ten justices of the peace (the report spells the tenth 'Roger Squires'; the Secretary of State listing's 'Roger Squire' governs).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists ten Dorset justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Russell Appelman, Howard W Coolidge, Tom Cooper, Lee Fox, Jennifer Halligan Comar, Michelle Pagan, Sandra "Sandy" Pinsonault, John "Will" Rucker, Roger Squire, and Bo Thorn. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded.
Town of Dorset 2025 Town Report (dorsetvt.org): the elected-officers table lists the same ten justices of the peace.
